found_while: B3 2d.1 -- wiring the daily learning report's (c2) HOLDING DISCIPLINE census
severity: the suite was writing into two append-only records that other code makes decisions from

how_it_surfaced.observation: state/decisions.jsonl had an mtime of 2026-09-05 20:02 local (12:02 UTC) -- one minute after a `python run_tests.py` finished, in a repo whose loops have been stopped since judging day.
how_it_surfaced.rows: six exit rows for PANW and NVDA, `HARD_RISK_LIMIT: shares at -9.00% against the 3% stop declared for profile 'default'`, decision_ids 20260905T1153 / T1154 / T1202 -- exactly the two suite runs.
how_it_surfaced.source: tests_smoke_contract.py:278 calls `exits.manage(RefusingClient(), deadline_utc=DL, dry_run=False)`. The client is fake; the LEDGER WRITE is real.

why_no_existing_guard_caught_it: AAT_TEST_MODE blocks the SOCKET. Nothing blocked the FILESYSTEM. `alpha/ledger.py:41` resolves LEDGER_DIR from AAT_LEDGER_DIR **at import time**, defaulting to `state/`, so a suite that sets the variable after importing alpha.ledger has already lost -- which is why the fix has to live in run_tests.py, the one place a child's environment is set. Same shape as the 2026-08-27 leak: only an env var reaches a child.
consequences_measured: daily_learning_report section (c2) counted those fictional rows as real exits in its exit-reason census.
the rows sit inside a hash chain that has been TORN since 2026-08-25. They were NOT deleted: editing a tamper-evident chain IS the tampering. They are recorded here instead.

the_second_leak_the_new_guard_found_imme.why_it_matters: this is the file `spend.spent_usd()` reads to decide whether a real LLM call is affordable. Fabricated rows inside a budget gate's own input. `alpha/spend.py:50` hardcoded the absolute path and ignored AAT_LEDGER_DIR entirely.
the_second_leak_the_new_guard_found_imme.fix: alpha/spend.ledger_path() resolves at CALL time and redirects to AAT_LEDGER_DIR **only under AAT_TEST_MODE**. Production is byte-for-byte unchanged, on purpose: moving a budget gate's input is how spent_usd() once read absence as $0.00 and re-authorised money already spent.

fixes: run_tests.py exports AAT_LEDGER_DIR to a per-run temp directory unless the caller set one (the same reason it exports AAT_TEST_MODE).
run_tests.py FINGERPRINTS decisions/counterfactual/fills/llm_spend/belief_series before and after the whole run and FAILS the run if any grew, printing the sizes and refusing to tidy up.

verification.after_fix: 74 suites, 3396 checks, ALL PASS, ledger REDIRECTED, no production ledger changed

known_fact_untouched: the decisions-ledger hash chain remains TORN at ~line 1203 since 2026-08-25. Reported, not repaired.
